messages.subject: deployApp - Minor bug
parts:
HI,

One of the new shiny.io features is the code checking. What is really great !

I recently pushed a new apps in which I use regular expressions of the form gsub("(.*)_(.*)+", "\\1", s)
It seems that backslashes are read as part ot a path, and deployApp() returns:
"The following lines contain absolute paths:"
...
"Paths should be to files within the project directory."

Not a big deal here, just to let you know.

Fred
